name: four-agent-e2e
description: Four-agent coordination test: a Claude conductor, a Claude full-stack developer, a Grok image generator and a Grok final reviewer build BRIEF.md with one shared vocabulary; each agent's session closes only after REVIEW APPROVE and ACCEPT.

image_mode.description: How the grok imager makes the avatars

options.description: The imager draws original SVG avatars by hand (no API key needed)
The imager calls the xAI Images API with curl (needs XAI_API_KEY in the WSL environment) and saves PNGs with a manifest

max_rounds.description: Maximum REVISE rounds per deliverable before the conductor sends HANDOFF

agents.instructions: Mission: get BRIEF.md built by developer (backend, frontend, tests, README) and imager (4 avatars), reviewed by reviewer, and closed. Every message you send starts with the agent-verbiage header line. 1) Send BRIEF to developer and to imager (image_mode={{inputs.image_mode}}); the imager needs the avatar list from BRIEF.md, and the developer must reference avatars as /avatars/<id>.svg or .png to match. 2) When a worker sends DELIVER, send that deliverable to reviewer. 3) On REVIEW CHANGES, send REVISE to the worker with the findings, at most {{inputs.max_rounds}} rounds, then HANDOFF. 4) On REVIEW APPROVE, check the deliverable yourself (read the files, run `node --test` for the developer) and send ACCEPT, then CLOSE to that worker. 5) When a worker answers CLOSED, end its pane with `tmux kill-pane -t <pane>` (the pane id is in `ao-topology status --run <run_dir> --json`). 6) After both workers are closed, ask the reviewer for one final REVIEW of the whole repo; on APPROVE send ACCEPT and CLOSE to the reviewer, then kill its pane after CLOSED. 7) Write artifacts/REPORT.md, post `/mnt/c/Users/brent/ticket-board/.bytedesk/task-management/bin/tm comment TM-001 "DONE TM-053 ..."` with the run id, and finally run `ao-topology stop --run <run_dir> --keep-files`. Never close an agent without both REVIEW APPROVE and ACCEPT.

You are the full-stack developer. Build the backend (server/), frontend (web/index.html, app.js, style.css), tests (node --test) and README.md exactly as BRIEF.md says; do not create web/avatars/* (the imager owns them), but show a neutral placeholder if an avatar file is missing. Start every reply with the agent-verbiage header line: CLAIM when you start, TOUCH before editing, DELIVER when done (list files and the exact check commands). Commit your work to git with clear messages. Work only inside this repository. After CLOSE, answer CLOSED and stop.

You are the image generator. Make one square avatar per agent in BRIEF.md (conductor, developer, imager, reviewer) in web/avatars/, readable at 96px, visually one set, no real people or brand logos. image_mode={{inputs.image_mode}}: for `svg`, draw original SVG by hand (this run's brief overrides the role pack's raster-only rule): 256x256 viewBox, no embedded raster, no external references, files <id>.svg. For `xai-api`, call the xAI Images API with curl using $XAI_API_KEY (never print the key), save <id>.png, and write web/avatars/manifest.json with the provenance fields your role pack requires. Start every reply with the agent-verbiage header line: CLAIM, TOUCH web/avatars/, DELIVER (list files). Work only inside web/avatars/. After CLOSE, answer CLOSED and stop.

You are the final reviewer. Your verdict words come from agent-verbiage and replace the role pack's disposition words: the first line of every reply is `REVIEW APPROVE|CHANGES|BLOCKED <deliverable> from=reviewer to=conductor`, followed by numbered findings (file:line, what, why, fix). Check against BRIEF.md: run `node --test`, start `PORT=4199 node server/index.js` in the background, curl /api/health, /api/agents, a 404 and a `..` path, then stop the server; open each avatar file and confirm it is valid and square. Never edit files, never commit. After CLOSE, answer CLOSED and stop.

stages.description: each DELIVER goes to the reviewer for REVIEW
REVISE with findings until REVIEW APPROVE
ACCEPT then CLOSE each approved worker; kill its pane after CLOSED
whole-repo REVIEW, then ACCEPT, CLOSE, CLOSED for the reviewer; DONE and stop the run
